_about: tinyagent-bench cloud references (OpenRouter). Per exact model id (never a :batch variant or a -latest alias): accepts = the request keys the model takes (temperature, top_p, top_k, seed; tinyagent-bench decision 2026-11-18: Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna take no temperature or top_p, Haiku 5.5 no seed, the Gemini models and DeepSeek all three); price_per_mtok = USD per million tokens in/out, used only when a response carries no usage.cost and for the dry-run estimate (recorded 2026-11-18; re-read OpenRouter's model list before a real run); provider = an upstream slug to pin with no fallback, or null for Harbor's latency routing (the provider that answered is recorded either way); reasoning_off = the reasoning option sent for the 'off' thinking variant, or null when the model cannot stop reasoning; replay_reasoning = send a reply's reasoning_details back with its tool calls even if Harbor's REPLAY_REASONING_MODELS lacks the model; context_window = the window the profile is saved with (Harbor's REMOTE_CONTEXT_WINDOWS where it lists the model).
